## Sentence filters

Chinese sentences of at most 20 characters, in Han characters, digits and
punctuation only, with a French (else English) translation, and at most
2 words outside HSK 1-4. Then, easiest first (fewest words outside
HSK 1-3, then shortest), a sentence is kept while one of its words appears in fewer than
12 kept sentences, until the bank reaches about 1450000
bytes ("overQuota" below). The learner is a minor: sentences
tagged as offensive, vulgar, sexual, violent or about drugs on Tatoeba (in any of the three
languages), or holding a word of the blocklist of the script, are left out; so are sentences
tagged "@needs native check" or with another maintenance tag ("@change", "@delete"...).
